{{Top|leg}}
A '''Strong-Stroke''' was a common [[Sedri (language)|Sedrian]] unit of measurement for distances. One Strong-Stroke was approximately equivalent to four hundred [[Meter/Legends|Imperial standard meters]].<ref name="BGS">''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''</ref>

==Appearances==
*''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''
